description.value: Hannam Supermarket is Western Canada's pioneering large-scale Korean grocery chain, founded in 1998 and now operating six Metro Vancouver locations serving over 4,000 customers daily. The Surrey store, open since 2003 in the Guildford area, stocks over 11,000 Korean food products and household items alongside a broad range of other Asian groceries. A touring cyclist looking to resupply with Asian pantry staples, fresh produce, or specialty items will find this a well-stocked stop.
